proved_step:
statement: For n-bit Boolean f, if the residues of #SAT(f) modulo pairwise-coprime primes p_1,...,p_k are known and P=∏p_i>2^n, then these residues determine #SAT(f) uniquely and permit its exact reconstruction in time polynomial in n+Σ_i log p_i.
proof: Let z=#SAT(f), so 0≤z≤2^n. The Chinese remainder theorem gives a unique residue r in [0,P) matching all supplied residues. Since z<P, z is the unique integer in [0,P) with those residues, hence r=z. Standard CRT reconstruction uses polynomially many bit operations in the total input bit length. This proves only the reconstruction bridge; it does not establish the required tensor translation, contraction ranks, or their running time.
